summary: Climber fell 70 feet from cliff top while setting top-rope at Boulderado, Boulder Canyon; fatal.
notes: ME 'Man dies in climbing fall' (run 471): 28-YO male, rocks directly above the highway at Boulder Canyon mile marker 32, lost footing, fell onto the road and was pronounced dead; year pinned by story-ID sequence + Sept-2 Sunday match (2012-09-02). Distance discrepancy noted: AAC says 70 ft (top-rope setting), ME says ~150 ft onto road.
